title: Oven Roasted Dutch Chicken Stew
description: A savory and romantic Dutch dish featuring sazon, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, perfect for a diabetic friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken breast with sazon seasoning and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the seasoned chicken breast to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the low sodium chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the stew in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
